steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add the spaghetti and cook until al dente.
Meanwhile, warm the oil and gently fry the garlic until pale gold.
Add a pinch of chili flakes, then turn off the heat.
Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Toss the pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water to emulsify.
Stir through the parsley and serve.
